privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information iyfpatna.in collects, why it is collected, and what we do with it. iyfpatna.in is operated by ISKCON Youth Forum Patna, the youth wing of ISKCON Patna.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: ISKCON Youth Forum Patna (IYF Patna) is the youth wing of ISKCON Patna and operates from Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple, Buddha Marg, Patna - 800001, Bihar, India. IYF Patna is not a separate legal entity; it functions under ISKCON Patna and its Temple Management Council.
For any privacy question, the contact address is given at the end of this page.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: Information you give us: when you register for a program, course or festival, or create an account, we collect your name, email address, phone number and, where relevant to the activity, your college or city.

Information collected automatically: basic technical data such as your browser type, device type, approximate region and the pages you visit. This is used to keep the site working and secure, not to build a profile of you.
We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13. We do not collect biometric, health or financial information on this website.

sections.heading: Payments
body: iyfpatna.in does not process payments and does not collect card, UPI or bank details. Where a paid activity such as a yatra is offered, registration and payment happen on that activity's own website, which publishes its own privacy, refund and terms pages and uses its own payment gateway.

sections.heading: How we use your information
body: To confirm and manage your registration for a program, course, festival or yatra.
To contact you about the activity you signed up for — schedule changes, venue details and reminders.
To share occasional updates about IYF Patna activities. You can ask us to stop at any time.
To keep the website secure and to understand which pages are useful, in aggregate.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We use a small number of cookies and browser storage entries that are necessary for the site to work: your language preference (Hindi or English), your light or dark theme choice, and, if you sign in, a session cookie that keeps you signed in.
We do not use advertising cookies and we do not sell or share your data with advertisers.

sections.heading: Service providers
body: We rely on a small number of trusted providers to run this site: a database host to store registrations, an authentication provider to manage sign-in, and an email provider to send confirmation messages. These providers process data only on our instructions and only to deliver their part of the service.
We do not sell your personal information to anyone.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Registration records are kept as long as needed to run the activity and to maintain our attendance and community records. If you ask us to delete your information, we will do so unless we are required to keep it for a legitimate record-keeping reason.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You may ask us to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop sending you updates. Write to the contact address below and we will respond within a reasonable period.

sections.heading: Photographs at our events
body: Photographs and video are often taken at our festivals and programs and may be published on this site or on our social media. If you would prefer not to appear, please tell a coordinator at the event or write to us and we will remove the image.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last reviewed.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of iyfpatna.in. By using the site you agree to them.

sections.heading: About this site
body: iyfpatna.in is the website of ISKCON Youth Forum Patna, the youth wing of ISKCON Patna. It exists to share information about our programs, courses, festivals and yatras, and to let you register for them.

sections.heading: Registering for activities
body: When you register for a program, course or festival, please give accurate information — we use it to contact you about that activity.

A registration is confirmed only when we confirm it. We may close registrations, change a schedule or venue, or cancel an activity when circumstances require it, and we will make reasonable effort to inform registered participants.
Most of our weekly activities are free to attend. Where an activity carries a fee, that fee, and the refund terms attached to it, are stated on the page or the site where you register for it.

sections.heading: Conduct at our programs
body: Our programs are open to everyone regardless of background. We ask all participants to behave respectfully towards other participants, towards temple staff and volunteers, and towards the temple premises. We may decline participation where this is not observed.

sections.heading: Acceptable use of the website
body: Do not attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the site, its accounts or its underlying systems; do not disrupt or overload the service; and do not use the site to send unlawful, abusive or misleading content.

sections.heading: Content and intellectual property
body: Text, photographs, artwork and design on this site belong to ISKCON Patna / IYF Patna or are used with permission, except where credited otherwise. The ISKCON name and lotus emblem belong to the International Society for Krishna Consciousness.

Quotations from the Bhagavad Gita and other scriptures, and works of His Divine Grace A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, remain the property of their respective copyright holders, including the Bhaktivedanta Book Trust.
You may share links to our pages freely. Please ask before republishing our photographs or written content elsewhere.

sections.heading: Links to other sites
body: This site links to other websites, including the separate site used for our Vrindavan Yatra registrations. Those sites publish their own terms and privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their content.

sections.heading: Availability and accuracy
body: We try to keep the information on this site current and the site available, but we do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted or free of errors. Schedules in particular can change at short notice — when in doubt, contact us to confirm before travelling.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Patna, Bihar have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
body: We may revise these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they were last reviewed.

legal.title: Legal Information
legal.intro: Who runs this website, under whose authority, and how to reach us.

sections.heading: Website operator
body: This website, iyfpatna.in, is operated by ISKCON Youth Forum Patna (IYF Patna).

IYF Patna is the youth wing of ISKCON Patna and is not a separate legal entity. It functions under ISKCON Patna — the International Society for Krishna Consciousness, Patna — and under the direction of the Temple Management Council named below.

sections.heading: Registered address
body: Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple, Buddha Marg, Patna - 800001, Bihar, India.

sections.heading: Founder-Acharya
body: His Divine Grace A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, Founder-Acharya of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness.

sections.heading: Management Council
body: The activities of IYF Patna are conducted under the ISKCON Patna Temple Management Council. Its members are listed in the footer of every page of this site.

sections.heading: Donations and payments
body: This website does not collect donations or process payments. Where a paid activity such as a yatra is offered, it is handled on that activity's own website, which publishes its own terms, refund and cancellation policies and uses its own payment gateway.

Please be cautious of anyone soliciting payments in the name of IYF Patna through channels other than those published on this site. If in doubt, call or write to us using the contact details below before paying anything.

sections.heading: Trademarks and content credits
body: "ISKCON" and the ISKCON lotus emblem are marks of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness and are used here as its Patna youth wing.
Scriptural translations and purports quoted on this site are the property of the Bhaktivedanta Book Trust and are used for educational and devotional purposes.

sections.heading: Grievances and contact
body: For any complaint, correction request or legal notice concerning this website, write to us at the email address below or at the registered address above, and we will respond within a reasonable period.
